The '''Graush dynasty''' was a dynasty of [[Sith King]]s of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="POLS" /> In [[7000 BBY]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Dathka Graush/Legends|Dathka Graush]] and his forces championed a [[Korriban civil war (Dathka Graush)|civil war]] that resulted in the destruction of the majority of Korriban's population centers.<ref name="TEA" /> Graush emerged victorious and was crowned [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> During his reign, Graush expanded his reach across Korriban's territories until two-thirds of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] submitted to his rule. Graush dominated his kinsfolk in a manner that was considered extremely brutal even by Sith standards, and his endeavors of bloodshed and terror saw countless corpses strewn across the battlefield in his wake. The dynasty ultimately culminated with his [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], and the Sith King was [[Dathka Graush's tomb|interred]] within Korriban's [[Valley of Golg]].<ref name="POLS" /> The Sith King [[Hakagram Graush]] shared his surname with the Graush dynasty.<ref name="BOS" />
